title: 2012年考研英语一 Part B · 七选五

sentences: Directions; In the following text, some sentences have been removed.
For Questions 41-45, choose the most suitable one from the list A—G to fit into each of the numbered blanks.
There are two extra choices, which do not fit in any of the blanks.
Mark your answers on ANSWER SHEET 1.
(10 points)
translations: 说明；在下面的文本中，一些句子已被删除。
对于问题41-45，从列表A—G中选择最合适的一个填入每个编号的空白处。
有两个额外的选项，它们不适合任何空白处。
在答题卡1上标记你的答案。

sentences: Think of those fleeting moments when you look out of an aeroplane window and realise that you are flying, higher than a bird.
Now think of your laptop, thinner than a brown-paper envelope, or your cellphone in the palm of your hand.
Take a moment or two to wonder at those marvels.
You are the lucky inheritor of a dream come true.
translations: 想想那些短暂的时刻，当你从飞机窗口望出去，意识到你正在飞行，比鸟飞得更高。
现在想想你的笔记本电脑，比牛皮纸信封还薄，或者你手掌中的手机。
花一两分钟惊叹这些奇迹。
你是一个梦想成真的幸运继承者。

sentences: The second half of the 20th century saw a collection of geniuses, warriors, entrepreneurs and visionaries labour to create a fabulous machine that could function as a typewriter and printing press, studio and theatre, paintbrush and gallery, piano and radio, the mail as well as the mail carrier.
translations: 20世纪下半叶，一群天才、战士、企业家和远见者努力创造了一台神奇的机器，它可以充当打字机和印刷机、工作室和剧院、画笔和画廊、钢琴和收音机、邮件以及邮递员。

sentences: The networked computer is an amazing device, the first media machine that serves as the mode of production, means of distribution, site of reception, and place of praise and critique.
The computer is the 21st century’s culture machine.
translations: 联网计算机是一个惊人的设备，是第一台作为生产方式、传播手段、接收场所和赞美与批评之地的媒体机器。
计算机是21世纪的文化机器。

sentences: But for all the reasons there are to celebrate the computer, we must also act with caution.
(42) I call it a secret war for two reasons.
First, most people do not realise that there are strong commercial agendas at work to keep them in passive consumption mode.
Second, the majority of people who use networked computers to upload are not even aware of the significance of what they are doing.
translations: 但是，尽管有种种理由庆祝计算机，我们也必须谨慎行事。
（42）我称之为秘密战争有两个原因。
首先，大多数人没有意识到有强大的商业议程在起作用，使他们处于被动消费模式。
其次，大多数使用联网计算机上传的人甚至没有意识到他们所做事情的重要性。

sentences: All animals download, but only a few upload.
Beavers build dams and birds make nests.
Yet for the most part, the animal kingdom moves through the world downloading.

Humans are unique in their capacity to not only make tools but then turn around and use them to create superfluous material goods—paintings, sculpture and architecture—and superfluous experiences—music, literature, religion and philosophy.
translations: 所有动物都下载，但只有少数上传。
海狸筑坝，鸟儿筑巢。
然而，在大多数情况下，动物王国通过下载在世界中移动。
人类的独特之处在于他们不仅能制造工具，还能反过来用它们创造多余的物质产品——绘画、雕塑和建筑——以及多余的体验——音乐、文学、宗教和哲学。

sentences: For all the possibilities of our new culture machines, most people are still stuck in download mode.

Even after the advent of widespread social media, a pyramid of production remains, with a small number of people uploading material, a slightly larger group commenting on or modifying that content, and a huge percentage remaining content to just consume.
translations: 尽管我们的新文化机器有种种可能性，大多数人仍然停留在下载模式。
即使在广泛的社交媒体出现之后，生产金字塔仍然存在，少数人上传材料，稍大的一组人评论或修改内容，而绝大多数人满足于仅仅消费。

sentences: Television is a one-way tap flowing into our homes.
The hardest task that television asks of anyone is to turn the power off after he has turned it on.
translations: 电视是一个单向的水龙头，流入我们的家。
电视要求任何人做的最难的任务是在打开电源后关掉它。

sentences: What counts as meaningful uploading?
My definition revolves around the concept of “stickiness” —creations and experiences to which others adhere.
translations: 什么算作有意义的上传？
我的定义围绕“粘性”的概念——他人坚持的创作和体验。

sentences: [A] Of course, it is precisely these superfluous things that define human culture and ultimately what it is to be human.
Downloading and consuming culture requires great skills, but failing to move beyond downloading is to strip oneself of a defining constituent of humanity.
translations: [A] 当然，正是这些多余的东西定义了人类文化，并最终定义了作为人的意义。
下载和消费文化需要高超的技能，但未能超越下载就是剥夺自己作为人的一个定义性组成部分。

sentences: [B] Applications like tumblr.com, which allow users to combine pictures, words and other media in creative ways and then share them, have the potential to add stickiness by amusing, entertaining and enlightening others.
translations: [B] 像tumblr.com这样的应用程序，允许用户以创造性的方式结合图片、文字和其他媒体，然后分享它们，有可能通过娱乐、消遣和启发他人来增加粘性。

sentences: [C] Not only did they develop such a device but by the turn of the millennium they had also managed to embed it in a worldwide system accessed by billions of people every day.
translations: [C] 他们不仅开发了这样的设备，而且到千年之交，他们还设法将其嵌入一个每天有数十亿人访问的全球系统中。

sentences: [D] This is because the networked computer has sparked a secret war between downloading and uploading—between passive consumption and active creation—whose outcome will shape our collective future in ways we can only begin to imagine.
translations: [D] 这是因为联网计算机引发了下载和上传之间——被动消费和主动创造之间——的秘密战争，其结果将以我们只能开始想象的方式塑造我们的集体未来。

sentences: [E] The challenge the computer mounts to television thus bears little similarity to one format being replaced by another in the manner of record players being replaced by CD players.
translations: [E] 因此，计算机对电视的挑战与一种格式被另一种格式取代（如唱片机被CD播放器取代）几乎没有相似之处。

sentences: [F] One reason for the persistence of this pyramid of production is that for the past half-century, much of the world’s media culture has been defined by a single medium—television—and television is defined by downloading.
translations: [F] 这种生产金字塔持续存在的一个原因是，在过去半个世纪里，世界媒体文化的大部分是由单一媒体——电视——定义的，而电视是由下载定义的。

sentences: [G] The networked computer offers the first chance in 50 years to reverse the flow, to encourage thoughtful downloading and, even more importantly, meaningful uploading.
translations: [G] 联网计算机提供了50年来第一次机会来逆转潮流，鼓励深思熟虑的下载，更重要的是，有意义的上传。
